classification_definitions.integration: Core target materially traverses real project protocol/store/runtime or actual OS filesystem-loader output/error boundary; incidental files do not suffice.
classification_definitions.unit: Local validation/parsing/permission/path-selection/concurrency or synthetic dependency feed; incidental fixture files and injected unconnected pipes do not grant a real project protocol boundary.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct independent local-only assertion blocks and material actual boundary blocks coexist.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Source mapping or reached boundary is insufficient or contradicted; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.

func HomeStreamConfig(replicas int) jetstream.StreamConfig {
	return jetstream.StreamConfig{
		Name:              StreamName,
		Description:       "Fenced global region roster and database directory",
		Subjects:          []string{protocol.GlobalStateStreamSubject()},
		Retention:         jetstream.LimitsPolicy,
		MaxConsumers:      -1,
		MaxMsgs:           -1,
		MaxBytes:          -1,
		MaxMsgsPerSubject: -1,
		MaxMsgSize:        maxMessageBytes,
		Storage:           jetstream.FileStorage,
		Replicas:          replicas,
		DenyDelete:        true,
		DenyPurge:         true,
		AllowDirect:       false,
		Metadata:          map[string]string{"terrascale-contract": contract, "terrascale-role": "home"},
	}
}
